description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Themostat Cap and Gasket for the Tracker & Sidekick.
Fits the 1.6 Liter / 8 Valve engine.
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Thermostat Cap/Housing
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Sidekick 1989 – 1991 1.6 Liter / 8 Valve engine
Geo Tracker 1989 – 1991 1.6 Liter / 8 Valve engine
